notes: All 49 source morphemes and 59 target tokens are partitioned exactly once, with one `added` unit.
The clause writes `אֹתוֹ` twice and the ASV writes one *him* after the verb, so the fronted occurrence is the unrendered one and is `unrepresented` under rule 22.
The italic *and* before *afterwards* answers to no conjunction morpheme in that colon and is `added` (rules 7, 14).
`וְעַתָּה` is divided as rule 14 directs — *Now* to the adverb whose lexeme it writes and *therefore* to the waw — though the waw's word stands second.
Both paragogic nuns are `unrepresented` while the directive `he` of `הַבָּמָתָה` takes the written *to* (rule 32).
